web-content-43a911a5f8c6.da5a00294d24ace: It's a 30-day grace period, not instant deletion
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.af12d7cf2baee1d: in Settings does not wipe your data right away. avaTOK schedules the deletion for
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.98c3a7ebab6fbbf: and marks your account as pending. Nothing about your profile, listings, bookings, or history is touched during those 30 days.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.b0e3faf99a9d08d: and confirm in the dialog. The app calls avaTOK's servers to schedule the deletion; if that call fails, you'll see an error and your account is
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.8944a546b8d36ff: scheduled — nothing silently happens in the background.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.5cd459322fc087d: deleted at this point — it's kept intact on purpose, specifically so you can sign back in and reactivate during the grace window.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.eb5351eef3cfe23: Your account, content and history stay exactly as they were.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.118f06b9b2cbee2: If you sign back in during those 30 days
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.6a7871a7e84e010: , avaTOK checks for a pending deletion on every login (Google or email code) and tells you the account is scheduled for deletion. You're offered the choice to reactivate — cancelling the deletion — or to stay signed out and let it proceed. If you sign back in during the grace period and aren't shown this choice, email support@saathum.com straight away so the deletion can be cancelled for you.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.b4deafb90a68e7c: If the 30 days pass with no reactivation
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.daa3023b280482d: , the deletion cascade runs and removes your data from avaTOK's systems, as described below.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.9dc4061b3f1d05a: What is removed after the 30 days
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.ee1930bf217ea92: Once the grace period elapses, avaTOK deletes your profile, settings, uploaded media and files, message inbox, follows/blocks/mutes, push tokens, community memberships, verification status, calendar connections, marketplace listings and creator profile, your login account, and your analytics identity, among other stores tied to your account.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.c13e8f9dd54f1da: What is kept on purpose — this is not a bug
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.279d0c301ffe0cb: deleted, usually with your identity scrubbed from them so they can no longer be traced to you:
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.0cfd6f1cdb0e131: is kept for financial record-keeping, with your details anonymised. Any unused token balance left when the grace period ends is
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.4a075c2ca826a49: , so withdraw what you can first. If tokens are held in escrow for an unfinished booking, the whole deletion waits until that booking is resolved.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.d6b01ea990ceedc: you had with other people are kept, with your identifier replaced so the other party's and finance records still work.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.e21905d8c2066ae: are kept, shown as posted by a deleted user.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.3871b100560b67e: Reports filed against you by other people
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.be46294ad97a48c: are kept — only reports you filed against others are removed.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.4093e337b2bbc30: Messages the other person already received
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.20acbd6f5ae3f33: stay in their inbox; only your own copy is purged.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.c6f4a56098329b1: If your account is under a legal hold
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.8d28ea08982a50f: (for example a serious-harm report we're required to preserve), deletion is paused for as long as the law requires.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.c069a67cf864d21: wiped the instant you request deletion. It isn't touched during the 30-day grace period, so if you reactivate you keep your verification; after that it's destroyed on the schedule in the retention policy, which for some users is later than the 30 days. See
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.cbfce74ffd1fb08: What might not be fully automatic yet
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.bbb46d2fa410322: avaTOK's deletion process cascades across many separate systems, and a couple of things are worth knowing plainly rather than assuming:
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.f17f61b5bc35403: If you've used avaTOK under more than one account identifier over time (for example after changing sign-in providers), data saved under an
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.d5e6277008b4b7d: identifier that the system no longer recognises as "you" may not be caught by the automatic cascade.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.03dc8d68db45155: Some connected external services are cleaned up on a best-effort, retrying basis rather than instantly, so a brief lag before everything disappears everywhere is normal.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.e9e0fe12c3d8e7b: If you want confirmation that your data was fully removed, or you believe something was left behind after your 30-day grace period ended, don't assume it will resolve itself — ask us directly.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.39a54fd0704f74e: Ask for a manual check or purge
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.fa89afe22f0e1f0: (or grievance@saathum.com for a formal complaint) with your account email and what you'd like checked or removed. This is the right route for confirming a deletion actually completed, or flagging data you believe is still hanging around after your grace period ended. See
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.df6122024c09500: policy for what to include and the timelines we work to.
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.eee23d9d9c9c1c6: Changed your mind before you even deleted?
web-content-43a911a5f8c6.dcee440e0263771: If you haven't tapped delete yet, there's nothing to undo. If you have, and you're still inside the 30-day window, simply signing back in is enough — you'll be offered the chance to cancel the deletion right there.
